label: Guide me: Tax audit

params.name: lede
params.default: Work through a tax audit in {product}: is one needed, what moved since last year, the Form 3CD clauses that apply, and the points still open.
params.label: lede

default.title: Pick the client
default.say: Choose the client; the year is picked at the top.

default.title: Is an audit needed?
default.say: From the turnover in the mapped books: above 1 crore for a business, 10 crore when cash is within 5%, 50 lakh for a profession, or presumptive with a lower profit. Tick what the books cannot show.

default.title: This year against last
default.say: Every mapped P&L and balance-sheet line against last year - from last year's statements, last year's filed return, or this year's previous-year column. New, gone, sharp moves and lines growing faster than turnover are flagged.

default.title: Raise a point
default.say: One click turns a flagged line into an audit point.

default.title: Form 3CD checklist
default.say: Only the clauses that apply to this client - partners, TDS, loans, stock and more. Mark each one with a note; an issue opens an audit point.

default.title: Audit points
default.say: What still needs an answer before the report is signed, each with who answers it. A preparer raises points; a reviewer, auditor, partner or firm admin clears them.

description_nl: 2026-10-04: the Tax audit walk, up to date with the screen; tours/sf-audit.json is made from it.
